title: CRM settings
responseHelp: How quickly a new lead should get its first reply. Dashboards and the lead inbox flag leads past this target. There is no default: until you set one, screens say the target is not set.
minutesHelp: For example 60 for one hour. Between 1 minute and 7 days (10080 minutes).
minutesInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 10080.
notSet: No response target is set. Leads are not flagged as late.
readOnly: Only members who manage settings can change the target.
